paragraphs: Spond sells a free app and a club management product for organising clubs, teams and groups, whatever the sport or activity.

Event types include single events, repeating events, a season planner and time poll events, with a waiting list once the maximum number of participants is reached. Payment requests can be created within a group or its subgroups to collect money for a trip, annual membership fees or new uniforms. The messaging tool is described as fully GDPR-compliant, with traceability for all users and oversight for parents and guardians.

The site addresses coaches, club admins, members, parents and team leaders across thousands of clubs. Organisations and schools appear among the audience groups the site lists alongside group admins and coaches, guardians and parents, and participants and players.

quote.text: Spond is a free app and club management solution, created to simplify how people manage their clubs, teams and groups in a safe and stress-free way, no matter the activity or sport!
